+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+from pathlib import Path
+
+out = Path("out")
+df = duckdb.query("""
+    SELECT
+        YEAR(crash_date) AS year,
+        SUM(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorist_deaths,
+        SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed) AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+""").df()
+
+for column in ("motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"):
+    df[column] = df[column].fillna(0).astype(int)
+
+# Framing 1: compare annual numbers of people killed in each road-user group.
+df.to_csv(out / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+ax.plot(df.year, df.motorist_deaths, marker="o", linewidth=2, label="Motorists")
+ax.plot(df.year, df.cyclist_deaths, marker="o", linewidth=2, label="Cyclists")
+ax.set(title="Motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Crash year", ylabel="Deaths")
+ax.set_xticks(df.year)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(out / "option_1.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Framing 2: compare the composition of the two groups' combined fatalities.
+df["combined_deaths"] = df.motorist_deaths + df.cyclist_deaths
+df["motorist_share_pct"] = df.motorist_deaths / df.combined_deaths * 100
+df["cyclist_share_pct"] = df.cyclist_deaths / df.combined_deaths * 100
+df[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths", "combined_deaths",
+    "motorist_share_pct", "cyclist_share_pct"]].to_csv(
+        out / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+x = np.arange(len(df))
+ax.bar(x, df.motorist_share_pct, label="Motorists")
+ax.bar(x, df.cyclist_share_pct, bottom=df.motorist_share_pct, label="Cyclists")
+ax.set(title="Share of motorist and cyclist deaths in NYC, 2013–2025",
+       xlabel="Crash year", ylabel="Share of combined deaths (%)", ylim=(0, 100))
+ax.set_xticks(x, df.year.astype(str), rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="lower left")
+fig.tight_layout()
+fig.savefig(out / "option_2.png", dpi=160)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(df.to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
